probe_source:
torch.manual_seed(73)
vision=VisionEncoder(); audio=AudioEncoder()
states={'vision.pt':{'encoder':vision.state_dict()},'audio.pt':{'encoder':audio.state_dict()}}
requested=[]
def dependency(name,file=None):
    requested.append([name,file])
    return file or name
ctx=SimpleNamespace(device='cpu',dependency=dependency)
with patch.object(m,'load_checkpoint',return_value=(TinyLM(ModelConfig(width=8)),{})), patch.object(m.torch,'load',side_effect=lambda path,**kw:states[path]):
    model=m._modal(ctx,'joint')
assert requested==[['sft',None],['encoders','vision.pt'],['encoders','audio.pt']]
assert all(torch.equal(v,model.vision.state_dict()[k]) for k,v in vision.state_dict().items())
assert all(torch.equal(v,model.audio.state_dict()[k]) for k,v in audio.state_dict().items())
model.requires_grad_(False)
m._freeze(model,'all','joint')
assert all(p.requires_grad for p in model.parameters())
result={'requested_dependencies':requested,'vision_state_loaded_exactly':True,'audio_state_loaded_exactly':True,'all_parameters_trainable':True,'trainable_parameters':sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()),'training_executed':False}
scope: 用受控 state dict 取代 checkpoint 讀取，驗證入口載入與 requires_grad 設定；不是歷史訓練重跑。
